name: Static Data Partition Method
definition: A data partitioning strategy chosen for isocontour visualization in the BSP-Disk model to minimize communication overhead. It partitions data among multiple computational nodes at the preprocessing stage and builds an external interval tree as the index structure for blocks on each disk.
summary: The Static Data Partition Method distributes massive datasets across nodes at preprocessing to minimize communication overhead, distinguishing itself by fixing data-to-node mappings permanently rather than migrating data at runtime.
